newsitem.title: USA: Peoples to buy Atlantic Bancorp.
newsitem.headline: Peoples to buy Atlantic Bancorp.

text.p: Peoples Heritage Financial Group Inc said on Tuesday that it agreed to purchase Atlantic Bancorp for $70.8 million.
Peoples said in a news release that it expected the transaction to be accretive in the first year of operations.
Atlantic is the parent company of Atlantic Bank N.A., also of Portland, Peoples said.
The purchase price is equivalent to 1.6 times Atlantic's book value at March 31, 1997 and represents a deposit premium of 10.7 percent, Peoples said.
Atlantic has assets of $470.2 million, deposits of $366.6 million, net loans of $375.4 million and stockholders' equity of $44.4 million.
The acquisition should be completed this fall if approved by regulators, and will be accounted for as a purchase, Peoples said.
